description: Triggers for Operate-stage work: watching released changes, SLOs and error budgets from the spec, alert triage, incident response, blameless postmortems, DORA metrics and from-production intake

queries.query: The checkout alert just fired at 8% errors over 15 minutes, what do we do first?
Write the blameless postmortem for yesterday's SEV2 outage on the reports service
Release v2.14.0 closed two days ago; do the 7-day indicator reading and open ops.md
Derive SLOs and an error budget for the export feature from what the spec already says
Compute deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and MTTR for the last 30 days
This alert pages every night and clears on its own — what should we do about it?
A customer says exports are returning someone else's data. How severe is this and who runs the incident?
We're at 10% rollout; read the dashboards and tell me whether to advance, hold or roll back
Turn the postmortem action items into from-production issues linked to the spec and AC
Define the signal, alert threshold and rollback command for the new export feature in the spec
Prepare the release notes and ask the Release Owner for sign-off on v2.15.0
Set up the CI pipeline with quality gates and environment approvals
This unit test fails intermittently; find the root cause in the code
Facilitate our sprint retrospective and record the actions with owners
Triage this new feature request and score its path
Review this pull request for security issues before merge
Stage 2 watch window is over; make the advance or roll back call and log it in the Deploy log
